text:
Ryan Patel: Heads-up: Orescape requested to onboard a custom summarization model trained on internal docs. They need PII filters + red-team eval before go-live. Account flagged for renewal in 3 months; want to see progress.

Amanda Chen: Thanks — do we have model artifact size / format? Is it a HF repo or S3 tar?

Ryan Patel: Vendor delivered a tar.gz w/ .pt + tokenizer files in S3. Size ~4.2GB. They ask for private deployment (VPC) and model pinning. Also want latency <= 300ms p50 for 512 tokens.

Elaine Park: Noted. Safety ask: PII scrubbing + deny list and allow list for PHI. We'll schedule evals: safety, perf, and hallucination checks. Assigning Ben for perf bench.

Ben Gomez: On it — will run perf on dedicated infra. Quick Q: quantized or fp16? If they need <300ms, likely need q4 or q8 and batching config. Ping @Josh Rivera for runtime constraints.

Josh Rivera: We can do q4/8. Need to confirm model architecture (LLaMA2-like?) and KV-cache support. Also check license — any restricted weights?

Ryan Patel: Model's license is commercial-friendly. Architecture: MPT derivative, not LLM standard; may need minor kernel tweaks. I've added sample inference API payload. S3 link: s3://redwood-uploads/orescape-models/v1.tar.gz

SafetyBot: Automated note: Uploaded artifact flagged for manual review due to tokenizer unknown. Queueing safety review job #SR-982.

Amanda Chen: For the onboarding timeline: propose 2 weeks for evals + perf tuning, then a staged rollout. Orescape wants enablement session for their ML team — Elaine can you own docs & session?

Elaine Park: I can. Will draft runbook and pre-flight checklist. Ryan, please share their top-5 prompts for evals and any sensitive categories.

Ryan Patel: Sending sample prompts now:
```
1) Summarize contract clauses
2) Redraft compliance section for layperson
3) Extract PII from docs
4) Escalate suspicious clause to legal
5) Generate safe explanation for end-users
```
They also flagged 'financial account numbers' and 'SSN' for strict masking.

Ben Gomez: Perf note: If we need <300ms p50 for 512 tokens, likely need batch_size=1 with A10/A100-class GPU and q4 quantization. I'll run baseline and post numbers tomorrow.

Josh Rivera: :thumbsup: I’ll start a private deployment staging cluster. Also recommend we enable KV cache and prefix caching for their workloads.

Amanda Chen: I'll update the renewal risk doc: move to 'at-risk -> active engagement' and record commitments. Ryan, can you share the support SLA they requested?

Ryan Patel: They asked for 99.9% uptime SLA and 2-week on-call for first month. I'll confirm in the next sync.

Elaine Park: Great. Next steps: Ben perf baseline, Josh infra prep, Safety team to run red-team by EOD Friday. I'll schedule enablement for next Tuesday. Anything else?

Amanda Chen: :white_check_mark: closing loop — I'll create a ticket in CS tracker and add all deliverables.
